meta.title: CV Woo — Tailor your resume to every job, without making anything up
meta.description: CV Woo reads a job posting and rewrites your resume to target it, keeping only what you have actually done.

hero.title: Your resume, tailored to every job. Nothing made up.
hero.subtitle: Upload your resume, paste a job posting: CV Woo spots what the recruiter wants, highlights your real experience and produces a resume ready for applicant tracking systems.
hero.note: 5 analyses a month free during the beta. No credit card.

preview.title: Front-end developer — Lyon
preview.disclaimer: Internal estimate, not an official ATS score.
preview.change: Rewritten: “Built the interface” → “Built a React interface used by 3 teams”
preview.source: Source: your experience at Atelier Nova

step1.title: Upload your resume
step1.text: PDF or Word. You review and fix the extracted details.

step2.title: Paste the job posting
step2.text: CV Woo pulls out the required skills, nice-to-haves and keywords.

step3.title: Get your tailored resume
step3.text: Every change is explained. You approve, then export to PDF or DOCX.

noInvent.title: Nothing invented
noInvent.text: Every rewritten line is linked to a line of your original resume. A new number or degree is blocked until you approve it.

ats.title: ATS-readable
ats.text: One column, standard headings, selectable text: recruiting software reads all of it.

score.title: A score you can explain
score.text: The score is calculated from evidence found in your resume, not guessed. You see what counts.

privacy.title: Your data protected
privacy.text: Hosted in Europe, private files, automatic deletion after 90 days (adjustable).

honesty.title: What's missing stays visible, never added
honesty.text: If the job asks for a skill you don't have, CV Woo tells you plainly. It doesn't write it into your resume for you.
honesty.item1: Skills you have, with the line from your resume that proves it
honesty.item2: Skills not demonstrated, to highlight better
honesty.item3: Missing skills, listed separately to help you grow

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: Yes, during the beta: 5 analyses and 5 resume generations a month, every template, PDF and Word export.
faq.a2: No. The model is forbidden from adding information, and an automatic check flags any number, date, degree or employer that isn't in your original resume.
faq.a3: It's kept in a private space hosted in Europe and deleted automatically after the period you choose. You can also delete it at any time.
faq.q4: Does the score guarantee an interview?
faq.a4: No. It's an internal estimate of how well you match the job, not an official ATS score.
